instruction: Cinematic wide shot of an indoor dance studio with a wooden ballet barre in the background. On the left, the blonde woman in a black long-sleeve top and leggings (R2) bends her torso completely forward over her split, head down. On the right, the young girl in a black leotard and white tights (R1) also bends her torso forward over her split, head down. The blonde woman and the young girl perform parallel forward stretches, their hands resting on the reflective floor. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused indoor light, creating a cool, neutral color palette with gentle shadows.
